findings.finding: POC001 claimed VM/device outputSha256 only syntax checked, no equality to actual produced media bytes; both profile PASS accepts f*64 with unchanged raw bytes.
findings.minimalFix: For qualified POC001 PASS, require scope output artifact reference to mapped nonempty produced_media artifact in selected slot and compare scope outputSha256 to computed byte digest. Keep command/thermal raw separately typed; preserve VM-first local and real-device production obligations and legacy record contract.
findings.directRegression: Both qualified profiles: valid synthetic produced_media baseline then only claimed hash drift, missing/wrong-kind output ref, actual media byte drift reject.

findings.finding: Qualified command_output file password=hunter2 accepted after true byteCount/SHA recomputation; existing secret_scan rejects identical decoded text when called directly.
findings.minimalFix: Scan decoded textual/command-output artifact contents with existing secret_scan before acceptance, preserving path/type/checksum binding and handling produced_media as binary. Decode/read failures must produce validation rejection rather than silent skip.
findings.directRegression: Qualified local/production valid safe log -> literal credential log with correct SHA/byteCount rejected. Include a read-boundary credential case if implementation scans chunks.

findings.finding: Every artifact is fully allocated via Path.read_bytes, designated POC002 output and each worker output are read again to hash. Valid file size has no bound, so working memory grows with artifact bytes rather than a bounded chunk.
findings.minimalFix: Calculate actual size and SHA with bounded reads/stat and reuse invocation-local validated digest in later output/provenance comparisons. Preserve selected-slot/samefile checks and real bytes/type/size equality; do not introduce a file-size acceptance cap or persistent decision cache.
findings.directRegression: Small synthetic file + read wrapper rejects whole-file reads and records max read size; repeated typed/provenance/worker digest consumers reuse matching computed result. No giant artifact or throughput benchmark needed.
